notes.title: THE ENDLESS DEMO UPDATE

notes.title: The 2.0 Update
notes.content: [p]New pistol ability added: THE STEALER[/p][p]Increased pistol attack speed[/p][p]Shotgun’s explosive energy now automatically recharges[/p][p]Remake of Level 1-2[/p][p]Added something to 1-2[/p][p]Minor fixes in Level 1-1[/p][p]Elevator intro revised[/p][p]Fixed issue in Level 1-2 where sliding up stairs would cause the player to get stuck in certain sections[/p][p]Major bug fixes[/p][p]Minor bug fixes[/p][p]Fixed keyboard controls not working in the level selection UI[/p][p]Improved physics effects on enemy corpses[/p][p]Adjustments in certain sections of Level 1-3[/p][p]Added more prominent visual effects on locks[/p][p]Redesigned and remade several textures[/p][p]Added more environmental effects and sound effects[/p]

notes.title: Into the Void DEMO - "THE VOID" Update
notes.content:
Into the Void Demo - "The Void" Update (v1.9)

Buffed Kick
Enemies can now be stunned
Added explosives
Remade 1-1 with updated enemy spawn positions and visuals
Added explosives to 1-2
Fixed an issue where the white flash would not disappear after respawning
Buffed Parry
Improved enemy attack visibility
Added a sound effect before Trashmen attack
Redrew several textures
Added new death screen sequence

notes.title: DEMO v1.85
notes.content:
v1.85

- Revamped Tutorial & Intro
- Revamped Title Screen
- Made the tutorial guide for the pistol more clear
- The health orb that appears when the pistol lands a headshot now disappears more slowly
- Increased pistol health recovery amount

notes.title: v1.81
notes.content:
v1.81

- Added a new skippable splash intro.  
- Timer now starts when leaving the lobby (except for 1-1 and the tutorial).  
- Fixed an issue where the boss health bar remained after restarting the level.

notes.title: RETURN OF THE GUARDIAN UPDATE
notes.content:
DEMO v1.8 - RETURN OF THE GUARDIAN UPDATE

- Added Phase 2 to The Guardian
- Nerfed The Guardian's difficulty
- Increased health orbs dropped by The Guardian
- Adjusted The Guardian's ground-breaking attack to be easier to avoid
- Added unique effects and sounds to each attack pattern
- The Guardian's white ring attack is now parryable
- Reduced The Guardian's health (80 → 65)
- A Whole new lobby
- New Inventory & Info
- Major & Minor bug fixes

notes.title: Demo v1.5 Update
notes.content:
8 new achievements
Redesigned game mode UI
Slight changes to the map design of some levels
minor bug fixes

notes.title: DEMO OUT NOW
notes.content:
INTO THE STEAM DEMO IS AVAILABLE NOW!

[h1]Demo v1.1 patch notes:[/h1]
Doors can now be opened with a sliding.
Collected keys are now displayed on the health bar.
Ingame Level Stats (Press TAB to use)
Gunner: Added new sound effects, Bullet timing now features additional effects and sound cues.
Reworked Level Selection UI
Improved Enemy sight system to prevent sniping enemies from long distances.
The main menu now reflects your current graphics settings.
House of Murder: Fixed clipping issues above the starting area door and staircase door, Added a new enemy spawn sequence in the bathroom, Fixed a bug that didn't kill enemies in a sliding section
Adjusted some enemy placements.
Fixed an issue where corpses would remain after loading a checkpoint.
Fixed various UI-related bugs.
Fixed the issue where the death count was not resetting.
Fixed the issue where a specific audio played regardless of the volume.

GO PLAY IT! (its better than itch.io build for sure)
